var mode: String = "tutorial" if get_tree().current_scene.find_child("Cutscene", true, false) else "standard"
	var round_num: int = $"../Stats&Items/Left/V/MinScore".rounds
	var target: float = $"../Stats&Items/Left/V/MinScore".min_score
	var score: float = $"../Stats&Items/Left/V/RoundScore".val
	var forwards: int = $"../Stats&Items/Right/V/Plays".plays_left
	JavaScriptBridge.eval("window.__aboutTimeSceneLoaded('%s', %d, %s, %s, %d)" % [mode, round_num, str(target), str(score), forwards], true)

var _hook_score: float = INF
var _hook_round: int = -1
var _hook_target: float = -1

var min_score: float = $"../MinScore".min_score
	var round_num: int = $"../MinScore".rounds
	if val != _hook_score or round_num != _hook_round or min_score != _hook_target:
		_hook_score = val
		_hook_round = round_num
		_hook_target = min_score
		JavaScriptBridge.eval("window.__aboutTimeScoreChanged(%d, %s, %s)" % [round_num, str(val), str(min_score)], true)
